name: Fruit Warp

features.name: Fruit Mode
features.description: Five or more fruits activate it.

review:
Fruit Warp is a cluster-style fruit slot where five or more fruits activate Fruit Mode, with a dynamic multiplier that can make wins much bigger.

Thunderkick rates it Medium volatility, with an 11,000x cap and a strong 97.0% RTP. It doesn't use paylines.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
